packageRules.description: Dependabot owns everything except the exceptions below.
pnpm itself, including the integrity hash in packageManager.
pnpm patch releases merge unattended: Renovate turns on GitHub's auto-merge, the pipeline supplies the approving review. Minor and major bumps get no auto-merge and therefore wait for a human.
DB theme packages, kept in one PR so assets stay in sync. Mostly triggered manually. No automerge: theme bumps change visual snapshots, and that diff needs human eyes.

DB UX core packages in one PR, so the platform shows the current release (Dependabot ignores them). No automerge: an update can change the Shell and the visual snapshots, and the Storybook links point to version/latest, so platform and Storybook should move together after a human check.
